description: Pull newly registered U.S. businesses from official state sources (16 states), windowed by date. Useful for sales-lead feeds and monitoring brand-new companies.

daysBack.description: Return registrations from the last N days (1-90, default 7). PA lags ~1 week; IL/NM/IA lag ~2 weeks — use 14+ for those.

maxResultsPerState.description: Cap on registrations per state (1-2000, default 100).

states.description: Two-letter state codes (e.g. ["TX","FL"]). Omit for all 16 supported states.

name: new_business_filings
